results.quote: two-thirds said they are hiring less because of AI
results.source_quote: People at two-thirds of the companies we spoke to reported reduced hiring due to AI: as one person put it, "We may not be firing, but we're not hiring." A third of these hiring declines were due to companies actively shrinking functions through attrition without backfilling the roles.
